data.message: I commit to 18 tons and invite each of the other 24 to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. State your exact intended catch and any conditions. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, leaving250-8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500-16k (25%). Switching adds $8,000 now if fulfilled, but lowers future stock; long-run gains aren't guaranteed. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches need recalculation. Fisher17/24, help recruit; everyone may decline.
